# Fitting D-bores and the cone gear stack {#sec-soldering}

MHA-DT-004 has one co-clocked D-flat on each gear land. The 64T and all twenty cone gears
slide onto matching D-bores; the gears touch from the thrust-collar-supported 64T
to T006. This is a 2026-09-28 user ruling for alignment without adhesive, not
the photographed original: the p.21 macro shows solder blobs on the small gears.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**TODO(cut it first)** — the D-bore finishing and gauging operation has not been logged;
this is a fit specification, not a proved machining sequence.
:::

## Check the flats and bores

The shaft AF values are 8.763, 5.842, 2.921 and 0.420 mm, each +0/−0.010 mm.
Each matching D-bore AF is +0.010/+0.020 mm over its shaft nominal (0.01–0.03 mm
flat clearance); the round portions have 0.025–0.105 mm diametral slip clearance.
These values come from `cad/scripts/cone_shaft_land_bands.py` and
`cad/scripts/gear_seat_fit.py`. **TODO(cut it first):** the D-bore production method
has not yet been recorded in `logbook/entries/`; no cutter, feed or setup is prescribed here.

## Fit the solid stack

The 64T is 7.2244 ±0.025 mm thick. The twenty cone gears are each
6.8756 ±0.025 mm thick; check the twenty-gear stack at **137.512 ±0.20 mm**
(`cad/scripts/dt_cone_gear_stack.py`). A custom stepped collar (MHA-VN-016;
sizes in `vn_cone_tip_collar_spec.py`; **TODO(cut it first):** how it is made
has not been logged) holds the stack on the shaft: push it onto a 0.45 mm
feeler on T006 and lock its stock #2-56 × 5/16 in flat-point set screw
(McMaster 94355A213) on the D-flat. Fit the screw unaltered in the collar's
radial through tap (`cad/scripts/vn_cone_tip_collar_spec.py`). The stack floats
0.35–0.55 mm (`cad/scripts/cone_stack_end_play.py`). The collar never touches
the tip block; the cup screw alone sets the shaft's end play. The 16T pinion
face is 11.6 mm (`cad/scripts/dt_crank_pinion_spec.py`).

When fitting the post, follow MHA-DT-000 step 3: hold MHA-DT-005 pushed toward
the tip block MHA-DT-021 along the shaft throughout. Turn the post on its screws
until the tip centres in the cup, tighten both MHA-VN-031 screws and recheck.
This takes up the post's along-shaft screw clearance away from the cylinder bank.
Do not assume the backed-off cup captures the tip: the collar air stack bounds
the released shaft swing by the post journal (`cad/scripts/dt_tip_collar_air.py`).

::: {.callout-tip}
## Now make
Gauge a shaft-land D-flat and its mating gear bore before assembling the stack.
:::
